routes.label: Choose the input that produces f(x)

question: If \(f(2x)=\frac{2}{2+x}\) for all \(x\gt0,\) then \(2f(x)=\)
solution:
To change \(f(2x)\) into \(f(x)\), substitute \(x/2\) for the input variable in the given identity. For \(x>0\), we also have \(x/2>0\), so the identity applies:
\[
f(x)=\frac{2}{2+x/2}=\frac{4}{4+x}.
\]
Multiplying by \(2\) now gives
\[
\boxed{2f(x)=\frac{8}{4+x}},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\). The denominator is positive for every \(x>0\).
